info.title: OpenRouter Data Archive API
info.description: Independent, unofficial daily archive and read-only query service for public OpenRouter data. Official JSON/RSS sources are attribution, not this deployment. Each attempt preserves provenance, timestamps, coverage and missing content. Failed collection never replaces last_success or publishes an empty success. Dates are UTC and historical coverage begins with the first real successful collection. Public model prompt/completion prices are USD/token; other original billing units remain unchanged. HEAD mirrors GET status/headers without a body; OPTIONS returns 204 with CORS headers. Only listed query parameters are accepted. Source bodies otherwise retain upstream content; credential-shaped official example strings are replaced before public publication with explicit redactions and original_sha256 metadata.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: One collected row dataset. upstream_openapi is a single row containing the entire official OpenAPI JSON object; docs_index/site_index each contain one {text:string} row. All 16 datasets can be queried; source metadata remains in the manifest.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring across row identity, name, description and title. Empty strings are rejected.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact model ID values; case insensitive. Valid for models, embedding_models, eu_models, image_models, video_models, endpoints, image_endpoints, zdr_endpoints.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact author slugs derived from the model ID prefix before /. Valid for models, embedding_models, eu_models, image_models, video_models, endpoints, image_endpoints, zdr_endpoints.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact provider names, slugs or tags; case insensitive. Valid only for providers, endpoints, image_endpoints, zdr_endpoints. Provider catalog rows use their own name/slug; endpoint rows use provider_name/provider_slug/provider_tag/tag. Model catalogs do not contain a reliable provider join; other datasets return 400.

parameters.name: min_context
parameters.description: Minimum context_length in tokens. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, endpoints, zdr_endpoints. Missing/non-numeric fields do not match. Decimal integer notation only.

parameters.name: max_prompt_price
parameters.description: Maximum pricing.prompt in USD per token, NOT per million tokens. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, endpoints, zdr_endpoints. Decimal notation without sign or exponent. Missing/null prices do not match. Does not interpret image endpoint price arrays or video SKU prices.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, endpoints, zdr_endpoints. true requires numeric prompt and completion prices both zero; false requires both present and at least one nonzero. Unknown prices are neither free nor paid.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Numbers sort numerically, missing values last in either direction. Identity is the ascending tie-breaker. Record identity uses model_id, id, slug, name, guid, then link.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Primary sort direction.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; decimal integer notation only.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of filtered/ordered rows or buckets to skip; zero based.

id.description: Dataset/source identifier. Also used for explicit unavailable-source reports.

coverage.description: Actual source scope and completeness limitations.

raw_path.description: Original body relative archive path, when saved.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of actual archived raw bytes after any declared redaction. For paginated lists this refers to the first saved raw file; page entries retain the other hashes. Dynamic endpoint collection uses the aggregate raw NDJSON archive hash.

original_sha256.description: Hash of the first response before credential-example redaction, only when that response was changed. See individual pages/raw request metadata for all original hashes.

pages.description: Actual request provenance for each paginated source response; not every source type uses pages.

DatasetReport.description: Actual source provenance for one run. Unknown source/report fields are preserved. Unavailable/failed source reports do not imply successful empty data. Credential-shaped strings in official examples are explicitly replaced before publication, with original_sha256 and redactions metadata; the archive does not silently claim byte-for-byte fidelity for changed content.

stale.description: True if no last successful run or its completion is more than 36 hours old. A failed latest attempt can degrade health even while stale is false.

total.description: Number of distinct dimension buckets after filtering.

matched_records.description: Number of filtered source rows before bucket pagination.

missing_count.description: Filtered rows lacking any value for this dimension. Values are deduplicated within a row. Multi-valued modalities/parameters can make bucket sums exceed matched_records; provider aggregation uses at most one canonical value per row.

RawRow.description: Original upstream row fields, nulls and unknown future fields are preserved. Flattened endpoints retain model_id. model_count has one {count} row; upstream_openapi has one entire official specification object; docs_index/site_index have one {text} row each.

Pricing.description: Upstream prices. Model prompt/completion are USD per token decimal strings, not USD per million tokens. Other charge keys retain upstream meaning; missing is not zero.

EndpointRow.description: Representative endpoints/zdr_endpoints row. Performance fields reflect short upstream windows, not complete historical measurements. null remains unknown.

ImageEndpointRow.description: Dedicated image endpoint pricing retains billable+unit; these rows do not imply a prompt/completion USD/token pair.

VideoModelRow.description: Video capabilities and original SKU price units; not a text-token price table.

guid.description: Original parsed XML guid; attribute-bearing values retain #text and @_isPermaLink.

RssRow.description: Parsed fields from models/blog/status RSS. A current feed window is not complete publication or incident history.

items.description: Shape depends on type; all extra upstream properties and nulls are retained. See x-dataset-schemas mapping.

UpstreamOpenApiRow.description: Official OpenRouter OpenAPI JSON document as one row, distinct from this service specification. Credential-shaped example values are replaced with the declared marker before public publication; manifest original_sha256/redactions reports the exception.

count.description: Number of credential-shaped matches replaced before public archive publication; dataset level aggregates matches across source pages.

reason.const: Credential-shaped upstream examples are removed before public publication.

Redactions.description: Explicit source-fidelity exception for credential-shaped official example strings. This is not data backfilling or a claim to hold working credentials.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the actual publicly archived body after any declared redaction.

original_sha256.description: SHA-256 of response bytes before redaction; present only when redaction occurred.
